name: The Tokyo EDITION Toranomon
positioning: Contemporary EDITION hotel in Tokyo's Toranomon district, designed by Kengo Kuma with the vision of Ian Schrager, with views of Tokyo Tower
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led city hotel with Tokyo Tower views
Guests who enjoy cocktail bars and a Wagyu steakhouse

facts.text: The hotel was designed by Kengo Kuma with the vision of Ian Schrager.
The hotel is near the Kamiyacho, Roppongi-Itchome and Toranomon subway stations.
Guest rooms offer views of Tokyo Tower and Tokyo Bay.
The Jade Room + Garden Terrace has views of Tokyo Tower and the city skyline.
Gold Bar at EDITION is a cocktail bar on the ground floor next to the hotel entrance.
The Lobby Bar overlooks Tokyo Bay and Tokyo Tower and offers an afternoon tea service.
The Blue Room serves breakfast, lunch and dinner, with plant-based salads, local market fish and grilled meats.
The spa uses products organically sourced and made in Japan.
The gym is powered by Technogym and open 24 hours.
The pool area is designed like a conservatory with high windows for natural light.

highlights.text: The hotel has accommodation with private terraces starting from level 31.
The Jade Room + Garden Terrace is the hotel's signature restaurant, a modern Wagyu steakhouse.
The Garden Terrace is open seasonally and sits 140 meters above the city.
Gold Bar at EDITION takes classic cocktails such as the Martini, Daiquiri and Manhattan further, using modern techniques and local Japanese flavors.
Custom-built EDITION bikes by tokyobike are available for complimentary hire.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed and the property is smoke free.
WhataHotel notes the business district setting may feel less traditional Tokyo atmosphere.
